findings.text: this production caller passes no replay_log_path, so the new branch in reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:1105 turns every non-zero replay here into integrated_verdict 'not-run' with a reason saying the output 'cannot be read as a verdict on the run'; the acceptance still refuses so no behaviour is lost, but a genuine failing gate is now described as an unreadable measurement when the caller merely never asked for a log.

Path(str(pointer.get('repo') or '')) resolves an absent repo field to the current directory and passes the is_dir() guard at :84, so the guard promised as 'unverified when the repository could not be read' would instead read the pass's own checkout; reachable only from a pointer that carries no repo, which the docstring's own promise covers.

the pre-existing comment about a red or unreadable suite now immediately precedes the carried-settlement block, so it documents code that does not read suites; the red_suite guard it describes sits at :2563, and a reader following the comment arrives at the wrong branch.
